name: Devouring Mists (CR 5)
body:
A pack of ghouls ambushed and devoured a group of people when they were passing this bridge on a foggy night. Memory of this event still lingers and hungers for flesh of the living.

XP 1,600; CE haunt (a bridge, 20 ft. wide and 40 ft. long, over a stream); Caster Level 5th; Notice Perception DC 16 (to notice an unnatural mist rising); hp 10; Trigger proximity; Weakness tricked by hide from undead; Reset 1 day

EFFECT

Mist rises from ground, thickening and turning from white to sickly green. Vague, ghoulish shapes form in the mist as it becomes a corrosive, ectoplasmic acid fog that consumes flesh.

DESTRUCTION

The bridge must be collapsed, rebuilt, and then consecrated.
